title: Make qualification comparisons semantic and diagnostics content-free

commit.subject: Compare qualification identity and rails by canonical value

findings.summary: JSON SyntaxError, Node filesystem syscall errors, and bun:sqlite SQLiteError now map to fixed stderr strings. ArtifactProofError.reason and existing bounded qualification Error.message still print. Sample collector still swallows inner failures into collection-rejected; CLI sqlite mapping is exercised on init against a corrupt observation database.

deliverables.implementation: Identity and rail-policy equality now use the existing canonical() encoding instead of JSON.stringify, so object-key reorder is not a change and a changed field still fails. CLI top-level catch maps JSON/filesystem/SQLite failures to content-free diagnostics; stdout stays empty and exit status stays 1 on failure.
deliverables.tests: Added reorder vs changed-value coverage for identity and rail policy, plus CLI redaction cases that assert a neutral sentinel never appears on stderr.
deliverables.untouched: artifact-proof, core qualification, genesis inode/digest checks, proof validation, package hashes, P004 go-no-go/release-evidence, docs/help, and other owner lanes.
